name: @wengu/desktop
description: Wengu (温故) desktop app: the web app in an Electron shell

scripts.build: corepack pnpm run build:web && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.dist: corepack pnpm run build && node scripts/package.mjs
scripts.dist:linux: corepack pnpm run build && node scripts/package.mjs --linux --x64
scripts.dist:mac: corepack pnpm run build && node scripts/package.mjs --mac
scripts.dist:win: corepack pnpm run build && node scripts/package.mjs --win --x64
scripts.pack: corepack pnpm run build && node scripts/package.mjs --dir
